create_abstraction_pipeline_extension_ru.purpose: Selectable plan library for creating new project abstractions such as desktop utilities, AI/3D tools, Blender viewers and PDF slicers.
create_abstraction_pipeline_extension_ru.feature_refactor_boundary: Feature/Refactor catalog entries operate only on an existing verified project or completed Create build.
create_abstraction_pipeline_extension_ru.classification_rule: Each create_new_abstraction plan is standalone and category-bound. Do not combine Visual Studio, Game, PDF, AI Image, 3D, Blender or PDF-Slicer plans into one grouped entry.
create_abstraction_pipeline_extension_ru.stack_category_rule: Every entry must declare stack_category/catalog_category and a matching create_stack_nodes stack_node_id with chain_boilerplate_ids.
